India Faces Varied Weather: Rain Alerts, Monsoon Delays, and Heat

Several Indian cities are experiencing diverse weather conditions, with some areas under yellow alerts for monsoon rains and thunderstorms, while others anticipate a weakening monsoon and potential temperature rises. Lucknow has received early morning rain and an IMD yellow alert, and Ranchi expects light to moderate rain with thunder for the next three to four days. Haryana is forecast to see rain from September 7 to September 12, while Himachal Pradesh anticipates a weaker monsoon with light clouds or sunshine until September 12. Meanwhile, Kanpur is experiencing cloudy skies and high humidity, making the heat feel more intense despite lower temperatures. Some reports also indicate a delay in the monsoon's arrival in Kerala.
